_meta.title: Kingshot VIP Progression Dataset
_meta.description: VIP levels 1–12 with progression requirements, benefits, daily free bundles and one-time Special Pack contents. Conflicted source claims remain unresolved rather than silently canonicalised.

sources.role: Benefits, daily bundles, pack contents, prices, strategy notes and VIP 2–9 progression table.
Existing structured VIP XP/gem-equivalent baseline for levels 1–12.
sources.provenance: kingshot.net/vip-calculator; embedded metadata says cross-checked against kingshot.net, kingshotmastery, lootbar and ldshop and attributed to kingshotpro.com.

verificationIssues.summary: The detailed VIP 8 pack listing says Cost 49.99, while later prose says the VIP 8 pack costs around $4.99.
verificationIssues.canonicalAction: priceAmount is null until independently verified.

verificationIssues.summary: The detailed VIP 12 benefits list Attack and Health at +16%, while the later VIP 12 summary states Attack +12% and Health +14%.
verificationIssues.canonicalAction: Attack and Health values are null/conflicted. Lethality +16% agrees across both sections; Defence +16% is preserved from the detailed list because no alternative Defence value is supplied.

verificationIssues.summary: The owner document calls 2,400,000 VIP XP a cumulative VIP 12 total, while the existing structured dataset models 2,400,000 as the VIP 12 level requirement and its per-level requirements sum to 4,800,000 from VIP 2 through VIP 12.
verificationIssues.canonicalAction: No cumulative VIP XP field is published in VIP-001A. xpToReach follows the existing structured level baseline.

verificationIssues.summary: The detailed VIP 7–12 pack rows total 975 Amadeus Shards, but later prose states 1,105 total and says VIP 11–12 contain 580; their detailed rows total 450.

sourceClaims.location: later shard breakdown prose for VIP 11–12

verificationIssues.canonicalAction: No aggregate Amadeus shard total is published. Individual detailed pack rows are preserved.
